text:
[name]
Atlanta, GA · [email] · [phone] · [url]

REGIONAL DIRECTOR · AFFORDABLE HOUSING · NONPROFIT OPERATIONS

Twelve years at a national housing nonprofit, the last four as regional director for the Southeast: 80 staff, 11 local affiliates, and a $15M annual budget. Grew the region's output from 60 to 190 homes a year, raised a $4M capital campaign, and built the construction and finance systems that the national organization adopted in two other regions.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Habitat for Humanity International — Southeast Region (Atlanta, GA)

Regional Director (Jan 2022 – Present)
Responsible for program delivery, affiliate support, fundraising and operations across Georgia, Alabama, and the Florida panhandle. Direct reports: 7 (construction, finance, development, affiliate services, volunteer programs, advocacy, operations). Budget $15M (FY2026); staff 80.
• Grew annual home completions in the region from 60 (FY2021) to 190 (FY2025) by standardizing affiliate construction schedules, adding a regional pre-development fund, and negotiating a bulk-materials agreement that cut per-home material cost 11%.
• Led the region's first capital campaign: $4.0M raised against a $3.5M goal in 20 months (540 donors; three gifts over $500,000); proceeds funded a 32-home neighborhood development completed in 2025.
• Increased the regional budget from $8.2M to $15M over four years through government contracts (two state housing trust fund awards totaling $5.6M), corporate partnerships (14 new, including three Fortune 500 companies), and the campaign.
• Built the affiliate financial-health dashboard (quarterly, 11 affiliates, 22 indicators); two affiliates flagged early were restructured rather than closed, preserving 23 jobs and 18 homes a year.
• Expanded the home-repair program from 2 affiliates to 9; 410 critical repairs completed in FY2025 for older homeowners, 70% of them in federally designated disaster counties.
• Served as incident lead for the region's response to Hurricane Idalia (2023): 95 homes repaired within 12 months; $2.1M in disaster funding secured.
• Staff: reduced annual turnover from 24% to 13% by introducing a compensation band review, a supervisor training series, and a remote-work policy; the region's engagement score is the highest of the seven US regions for two consecutive years.
• Represent the region to state legislators and housing agencies; testified twice before the Georgia House committee on housing in support of the 2024 trust fund expansion, which passed.

Director of Construction and Programs, Southeast Region (Mar 2018 – Dec 2021)
• Managed the regional construction team (14 staff) and the volunteer build program (about 12,000 volunteers a year).
• Introduced a standard plan library (8 plans) and a bulk-purchasing program; cycle time per home fell from 14 weeks to 9 and cost per home fell about $6,000.
• Launched the regional construction-safety program; recordable incidents fell from 11 in 2018 to 2 in 2021.
• Secured a $1.2M federal self-help housing grant for two rural affiliates.

Affiliate Support Manager, Southeast Region (Jun 2016 – Feb 2018)
• Coached 11 affiliate executive directors on budgeting, board development, and reporting; affiliate on-time reporting rose from 55% to 95%.
• Led two affiliate mergers that combined four struggling organizations into two viable ones.

Construction Manager, Habitat for Humanity of Greater Birmingham (Birmingham, AL) (Aug 2014 – May 2016)
• Ran 20 to 25 builds a year with a crew of 4 staff and about 2,500 volunteers; passed every municipal inspection on the first attempt in 2015.

AmeriCorps Member, Habitat for Humanity (Aug 2013 – Jul 2014)
• Site supervisor on 12 homes; coordinated volunteer groups of up to 40.

EDUCATION
Georgia State University, Andrew Young School of Policy Studies — Master of Public Administration (part-time), 2020. Concentration in nonprofit management. GPA 3.8.
Auburn University — B.S., Building Science, 2013. GPA 3.4. Student chapter president, National Association of Home Builders (2012–2013).

BOARDS AND RECOGNITION
Board member, Georgia Advancing Communities Together (statewide affordable housing coalition), 2023 – Present; finance committee chair.
Habitat for Humanity International Regional Leadership Award, 2024 (one of three awarded nationally).
Atlanta Business Chronicle 40 Under 40, 2023.
Certified Green Professional, National Association of Home Builders.

SKILLS
Nonprofit operations and finance (multi-entity budgets, government contract compliance, audits), capital campaigns and major gifts, construction management and cost control, program design and evaluation, public policy and legislative testimony, Salesforce NPSP, Procore, Excel, Spanish (professional working proficiency).
